image_description: A close-up view of a beaded necklace against a white background. The necklace features alternating large, matte, dark reddish-brown oval beads and smaller, faceted, translucent green crystal beads. A single loose brown bead lies near the center. The strand curves in a U-shape, suggesting it is laid flat or draped.

artifact_observations.location: Center-left area, near the loose bead
artifact_observations.reasoning: A brown bead appears to be floating or detached from the main strand without a visible connecting thread, while adjacent beads are connected. The physics of the stringing appear inconsistent.
The refraction and internal facets of the green beads look slightly soft and plasticky rather than like sharp glass or crystal, lacking realistic caustic highlights.
The thread visibility is inconsistent; it vanishes completely behind some beads but is sharply visible between others, suggesting minor generation inconsistency in depth handling.
